issuerContext: Discover is 'a division of Capital One' (per discover.com calendar page footer). Capital One closed the acquisition in May 2025. Applications for Discover-branded cards are taken on capitalone.com (apply links like https://www.capitalone.com/apply/credit-cards/discover/?marketableOfferId=48356). Existing accounts move to the Capital One website/app in waves from 2026-07-27 through 2027 (secondary sources). Cards stay on the Discover network.

currentRotatingQuarter.cap: 5% on up to $1,500 in combined purchases per quarter ($75 max), then 1%
currentRotatingQuarter.activation: Required every quarter and not retroactive. Q4 activation opened 2026-09-01 and stays open until 2026-12-31 (secondary). Channels named by Discover: Discover mobile app, online account, 1-800-DISCOVER (1-800-347-2683), and the one-click email. Accounts that have moved to Capital One activate through Capital One (capitalone.com Discover FAQ). An activation already in place carries over when the account moves.

cards.notes: The $1,500 quarterly cap comes from the official calendar page text ('Earn 5% Cashback Bonus on up to $1,500 in different category purchases each quarter, when you activate. That's up to $75 cash back each quarter!'). The product page itself says only 'quarterly maximum'. The Q4 2026 categories and definitions are secondary because the official calendar was down. The product page shows a 0% intro APR for 15 months, then 18.49%-28.49% variable. Applications go through capitalone.com. Migration changes (secondary, FrequentMiler): the gift card minimum rises to $25, 'Pay with Rewards' via Apple Pay ends, and redemption toward the minimum payment ends. Capital One FAQ (official): 'we'll continue to match rewards earned within your first year.' Pay-with-Cashback-Bonus at Amazon/PayPal is a redemption feature and does not earn more. Its status after migration was not verified.

cards.notes: Relaunched in 2026. Applications for the old Discover it Secured (2% at gas stations and restaurants on up to $1,000 per quarter, 1% elsewhere, $200 minimum deposit) were paused on 2026-06-02. Capital One said: 'We are making some changes to the Discover it Secured Card, and while doing so, we have temporarily stopped accepting applications' (WTOP/US News, secondary). The official page now describes the rotating 5%/1% structure, 'Refundable deposits as low as $49', a $200 minimum credit line up to $3,000, and Cashback Match. WalletGrower (secondary) gives 2026-09-10 as the date it reopened to new applicants. Not on the discover.com/credit-cards/ index fetched 2026-10-01, so open status rests on the product page plus one secondary source. MoneyAtlas still shows the old 2% structure and paused status (stale). Per secondary sources, Capital One retired the published 7-month automatic upgrade review.
